That ghost story reminded me of the challenges we face in confronting the rising threat of a new type of fascism. Just as the villagers were afraid of the supernatural force, many of us today are afraid of the enemy that has attacked places like New York, Washington D.C., Bali, London, Madrid, Moscow, and so many other places. This enemy has made its intentions clear, and yet some people seem not to have learned the lessons of history. With the growing lethality and the increasing availability of weapons, can we truly afford to believe that vicious extremists can be appeased? Can folks really continue to think that free societies can negotiate or compromise with those who seek to destroy them? We must remain vigilant and take action to protect ourselves and our way of life.
